name: Shark Bait: GW × Tiggy
source:
Standalone one-shot featuring GW × Tiggy spice. 

Tiggy learns about Valentine’s Day and seizes the opportunity to distract GW from his workload by focusing his attention on a different kind of "load".

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
GW × Tiggy Spice的独立单镜头。

Tiggy了解了情人节，并抓住机会将GW的注意力集中在另一种“负担”上，从而分散GW的注意力。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
